The Banpresto Tuffy I Love Cheese Vol.2 Ver.B Bandai Spirits Figure brings the beloved character Tuffy from the classic Tom and Jerry series to life. This collectible figure showcases Tuffy's playful and endearing personality, making it a perfect addition for fans and collectors alike.

Manufactured by Bandai Spirits, this figure offers detailed craftsmanship and vibrant colors that capture the charm of the character. Its unique design highlights Tuffy's love for cheese, making it a standout piece in any figure collection.

Details

• Specifications:

  • Pre-painted
  • Collectible figure
  • Detailed design
  • Based on Tom and Jerry character

• Condition: Brand New

• Manufacturer: Bandai Spirits

• Recommended Age: 15+

Features

  • Pre-painted figure capturing Tuffy's playful charm
  • High-quality detailing and vibrant colors
  • Part of the Banpresto I Love Cheese Vol.2 series
  • Perfect for display and collection

Care instructions

To maintain your figure's quality, gently dust with a soft cloth regularly and avoid exposure to direct sunlight to prevent color fading. Handle with care to avoid damaging delicate parts. Store in a dust-free environment or display case for best preservation.
